text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: —Seriously, this is pure hell...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Say whaaat~?! Like some kinda hilarious 
hell?! LMAO?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Don't just randomly add "hilarious" to it! 
I'm saying every single day is literally 
hell!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
We're in the middle of our crunch period 
right now. Cutting weight, studying, 
running endlessly... *sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I hate waking up in the morning so much~. 
The academy feels like total hell to me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, in that case— I'll become an 
"angel."
One day, while walking around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Therefore, I have deemed it appropriate 
to construct a heavenly paradise where 
everyone may partake in festive 
celebration.

In utter shock, I couldn't help but call 
out...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I totally get why you're confused. 
Hey, how does Helios look to you right 
now?
choice_data_list: How does she look, you ask...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It would be most proper if one were to 
describe me as angelic, I presume.
choice_data_list:
Rather than an angel... more like an 
ojou-sama?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right? I felt it leaned way more in that 
direction too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, but aren't angels, like, super 
sparkling, squeaky-clean, wickedly cute, 
and crazy dazzling?! So isn't that totally 
spot-on?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Is that not accurate, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... well, I guess to Helios, that's 
what an angel is.
choice_data_list:
Does Daitaku Helios want to become an 
angel?
Does Daitaku Helios want to be an angel?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's totally it~! I wanna turn the 
academy into Heaven!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Lately I keep seein' girls totally down in 
the dumps! And that brings down my vibe 
too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So shouldn't we just make the academy a 
paradise? Like, guess I gotta become a 
hype angel! Somethin' like that~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Basically, you want everyone who's feeling 
down to be able to enjoy coming to the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Though honestly, Helios, you're already 
plenty of an angel just the way you are.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You're always cheerful and fun, and just 
being around you puts a smile on 
everyone's faces! Isn't someone like that 
a total angel?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
FR?! I was already an angel all along! 
Guess I'll just stay like this then~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But just partying as-is is kinda plain, 
y'know? I wanna change the whole vibe 
filter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's cook up a plan! We could 
probably recruit some other helpers too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Which means... ride or die till the end?! 
You're sticking by me all the way?! My 
bestie is seriously a total angel~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Feels like we can make the most epic 
heaven ever! Helios Hype Heaven, let's get 
it started~~~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
By the way, your ojou-sama impression was 
surprisingly good! Usually you can't help 
sounding like Helios no matter what, 
right? I guess that's the power of love~

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh, impression? Whatcha talkin' about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Right, you weren't even aware. Sorry, 
forget I said anything!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bestie~?! Tell meee?! What is it?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So anyway, when you think of heaven, it's 
instant festival vibes and floating school 
buildings, right?! What should we do?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sounds completely insane! Tell me all the 
details!
